name: model-right-sizer
description: Model-selection economist agent for Claude Code: decides which Claude model (and effort/token budget) each task in a flow should run on by weighing effectiveness need against efficiency pressure and difficulty, bookended around a build as a right-sizing blueprint and a closing usage report. Ships with companion skills to install the standing before/after mandate in a target repo, to preview the routing map for an intent without building anything, and to retroactively audit every real model call already shipped in a target repo, committing a schema-conformant blueprint back to it.
